#	Messy Notes   

The team’s “Q3 numbers” came in ahead of plan—the first time   
since 2019.	Margin held — just — at 38 %, and R&D spend was flat…






##  Highlights		

-   Revenue  up   12% year on year   
-	Churn down to 1.8%
- Two enterprise logos signed – both multi‑year
